steps.content: A deathly silence envelops the camp, so absolute that dust hangs motionless in the air, thickening it into a suffocating shroud. After a long moment, an advisor finally clears a dry, constricted throat, the sound unnaturally loud in the stillness.

steps.speaker: Farland Advisor
steps.content: The supplies aren't coming. Raiders hit our lines... Fraser's final Aurum Secretum convoy was lost. After that... holding the Black Ring was impossible.

steps.speaker: Farland Advisor
steps.content: And Synex just sent word that DisCity's "Shepherd" keeps breaking through our lines. We couldn't stop him from charging into the Black Ring.
steps.female_content: And Synex just sent word that DisCity's "Shepherd" keeps breaking through our lines. We couldn't stop her from charging into the Black Ring.

steps.content: The young Fraser general silently studies the reports before him. The situation has become nearly hopeless.

Frontline Report: The Apostle swarm originally concentrated around BR-005 has been forcibly diverted to the Broken Frontline by the enemy. To think they would actually dare to open their DisSea defenses and use a near-suicidal tactic... Are they really so confident in their defensive capabilities?

Frontline Report: Regardless, the enemy only needed to create a single breach in the frontline to easily attract the Apostle swarm we had painstakingly gathered using Aurum Secretum.

Frontline Report: The so-called "Secondary Black Ring" is simply no match for the power of BR-000. In actual combat, all theoretical strategies have proven to be worthless jokes.

Frontline Report: Forward Command initially assessed that if we could hold out until the FAC was overrun by DisSea Corruptors and the external Apostle swarm, we might still have a chance to turn the tide.

Frontline Report: But the enemy's tenacity has exceeded all expectations. For nearly three hours, their defensive line hasn't yielded a single step.

Frontline Report: Moreover, we underestimated those old military forces from the Nirvana Port ruins. That woman took to the battlefield in her massive steel machine, capable of engaging BR-005 directly.
Frontline Report: The situation is spiraling out of control, Headquarters. Forward Command believes we have lost all ability to influence the outcome.
The young general closes the communication channel and sighs. To him, these crises might still be reversible with enough effort. But there is one thing he truly dreads—

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: Any movement on the Undergrounder network? ...What's the word from the Senate?

steps.speaker: Farland Advisor
steps.content: They're urging a full withdrawal. Surrender is also acceptable, as long as we completely sever all ties with Fraser.
His voice is barely above a whisper, yet it rings in their ears like thunder.

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: ...Even the Furor Black Ring we bled to take... handed over on a silver platter.

steps.speaker: Farland Advisor
steps.content: They say... there will be other opportunities.

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: ...Heh. I know what they're really saying.

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: We've been abandoned, right? The Senate wouldn't dare make this call alone. Someone got to them—either convinced them the war is already lost, or bought them off.

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: Was it the appeasers? Or have DisCity's spies crawled out of the shadows again? Hmph. I should've purged them all before we deployed.
A heavy silence falls over the tent. Around him, officers and advisors stare at the ground, their hope extinguished like cold ashes. Yet the young general's eyes never leave the sand table.
He stares intently, not saying a word, until at last his calm voice breaks the silence.

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: ...Here's what happens next. I'll adjust our tactics, provide cover for the Aurum Secretum sorcerers, and launch another offensive. If you want to surrender, do it. Just stay out of my way.

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: The Aurum Secretum has strengthened our Black Ring. The Undergrounders' tech still gives us options. If DisCity's "shackles" have already breached the Black Ring and become a threat... then I'll use that. I'll turn this into our final opportunity.

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: If the Undergrounders were here, they'd say... this is the first fusion of shackles, Deus Corpus, and Mania's will. No one can predict what miracle might emerge.

He rushes back to the sand table. With the Apostles of Ashes diverted and his resources stretched thin, every second is critical. In the resonance pool, Aurum Secretum particles drift and swirl into ripples, disturbed by the battlefield's chaotic energy—forming a real-time visualization of the shifting Mania field.
His eyes remain fixed on the harsh red glow marking the shackles that are steadily advancing toward the heart of their precious Black Ring.
At last, it happens. That person breaks through all obstacles, piercing into the Black Ring like a blade, yet merging with it like a drop of water returning to the ocean.
Just as the weight of the moment settles, a piece of long-missed good news reaches him.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: Sir! The sorcerers have been delivered to the designated location! Your plan will proceed without fail! For victory, I swear to follow you even unto death!
Just in time!

His gambit activates at the perfect moment—any earlier, and the enemy might have detected it; any later, and all would have been lost. The timing is flawless. With this first critical step achieved, he is convinced: this is both a trial and a blessing, bestowed upon them by "God" Himself.
The young general clenches his fist and turns to address the soldiers still holding the line behind him.

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: The Black Ring belongs to the farlands. It hungers for change more than any of us. As long as it stands, so do we. The Ring will show us its will.

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: For our city-state! For glory! For our people, no sacrifice is too great! I swore an oath before this campaign: we will achieve victory. And we shall.

His words are met with the soldiers' fervent oaths, and the distant, ground-shaking roar of the Apostle Black Ring, locked in a stalemate with a colossal steel behemoth. Its cry is one of defiant rage, shaking the very earth beneath them.
It is a roar they have heard all their lives, echoing across all their ranks—a howl of fury, imprisoned by powerful, unforgiving new rules.

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: Come forth... DisCity's true weapon. This chance was bought with Adelaide's life. I will seize it with mine!
